headline: US Industrial Production Declines as Import Prices Rise
summary: US industrial production fell 0.4% in October, missing forecasts, while import prices rose 1.1%, exceeding expectations. Retail sales showed a modest 0.2% increase, slightly above forecasts.
why: These indicators provide a snapshot of US economic health, influencing Federal Reserve policy expectations and market sentiment.

impacts.name: S&P 500
impacts.why: Macro data influences interest rate expectations and equity valuations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Unexpected weakness in industrial production combined with higher import prices suggests potential stagflationary pressures, impacting investor outlook on interest rates.
